note: The fringe ledger's published families for the "fringe to skill" card (tools/fringe.mjs --publish, from tools/fringe.json): each family's live drafts, its research notes newest first, what its runs were built toward (near) and the core skills its notes name.

drafts.label: How small a button
drafts.sub: Tap the targets as fast as you can; Fitts's law predicts your time from size and distance.

drafts.label: The link turns over
drafts.sub: Inside every group more x goes with more y; pooled, the line can slope the other way.

drafts.label: Verse growth
drafts.sub: The benchmark score round by round, and what moved it.

drafts.label: Its side of the table
drafts.sub: Answer only the green dots. Does sharing the task with Verse slow you on its side?

drafts.label: When did it start
drafts.sub: Paste a series of numbers; a cumulative-sum test finds when a small lasting change began.

drafts.label: Quiet filter
drafts.sub: Paste headlines; the loud ones fade, the quiet signal stays.

drafts.label: Do they know
drafts.sub: Only how the answer arrives: the pause, the um. How sure do they sound?

drafts.label: Hold the lamp
drafts.sub: Hold for as long as the lamp was lit. Longer times drift more, in proportion.

drafts.label: Timing game
drafts.sub: How well do you feel time pass? Stop the clock by feel.

drafts.label: The pointing arrow
drafts.sub: An arrow hints where a star will appear. Sometimes it lies. How much does a hint steer you?

drafts.label: Count the flashes
drafts.sub: One flash or two? The beeps are not a clue, and they still change what you see.

drafts.label: What it hasn't heard yet
drafts.sub: How much of what people will ask has Verse already seen? Good and Turing's estimate.

drafts.label: Miss board
drafts.sub: Asks Verse could not answer yet, and what it learned from them.

drafts.label: Odd moments
drafts.sub: Log each odd moment; over days it asks whether they come in bursts more than chance would.

drafts.label: UAP timeline
drafts.sub: Public steps in US UAP disclosure, each with its confidence. Releases are events; the cases stay unresolved.

drafts.label: One in a hundred
drafts.sub: A positive test, an alarm, a strong hunch: how likely is the thing behind it, really?

drafts.label: Hypothesis ledger
drafts.sub: Weak signals held as hypotheses, each with its confidence and source.

drafts.label: The wrong lead
drafts.sub: Three words, one word that goes with all of them. Some come with a misleading hint.

drafts.label: Idea vault
drafts.sub: Seal a half-formed idea; it comes back to you later. Kept on this device only.
